questions.question: Who sent envoys to Hezekiah, and what did he show them?
options: Assyria; the walls and the gates of the city
Persia; his army and its weapons
Babylon; all his treasures and storehouses
Egypt; the gold of the temple alone
questions.answer: Babylon; all his treasures and storehouses

questions.question: What did Isaiah prophesy as a result?
options: All would be carried to Babylon, and his sons would be eunuchs there
A righteous son of David would very soon restore the fallen throne
The whole city would be graciously spared for very many more years
All of the treasures would be returned to him again with interest
questions.answer: All would be carried to Babylon, and his sons would be eunuchs there

questions.question: Hezekiah accepted Isaiah's word, glad there would be peace in his own days.
Nothing is left, said Hezekiah; they have seen all that is in my _____.
